title: pvWriteJSONImageWriter
body:
## pvWriteJSONImageWriter

Explicit-export writer that saves a uniform image (vtkImageData) node as a JSON document listing the image dimensions, origin, spacing and the values of its point arrays, for web or scripting tools rather than for re-reading in ParaView. Use it as an export `writer` with comparison "pixels": Schemaxis then parses the JSON itself and checks dimensions, origin, spacing and exactly the arrays the writer emits against the source image: one-component point arrays other than vtkValidPointMask, narrowed by ArrayName and Slice, with null where vtkValidPointMask is 0. The input must be non-composite image data; resample other datasets to an image first. For standard raster formats use pvWritePNGWriter, pvWriteTIFFWriter or pvWriteMetaImageWriter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ArrayName and Slice are honoured by the verifier: ArrayName must name a one-component point array (otherwise nothing is written and verification fails), and Slice must be -1 or below the image depth (a larger Slice is rejected with INVALID_SLICE before writing, because VTK does not bound-check it). Vector arrays and vtkValidPointMask are never written.
- The writer prints values, origin and spacing with 6 significant digits (VTK vtkVariant::ToString precision 6), so floating-point data usually needs a positive tolerance.
- Only pixels comparison is accepted and a custom readback reader is rejected for this writer.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `JSONImageWriter`. Identity: `writers/JSONImageWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ArrayName` | The name of the field to export. If Empty all fields will be saved. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Slice` | Write only one slice if slice >= 0 | `{"minimum":-1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-1` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "pixels",
  "extensions": [
    "json"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteJSONImageWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ]
}
```
